"""
INT. RAVENSWOOD THEATER - GREEN ROOM - DAY

Next morning. The green room is quieter. Leon sits at a makeup station reviewing his script. Oscar reads in the corner.

DIANA enters, consulting a BLUE CLIPBOARD. She sets it on the table and turns to Leon.

DIANA
Leon. The stage physician cleared you for full movement. Any pain, you stop.

LEON
Understood. Honestly, the whole thing was a fluke. I was in a car accident -- the other driver ran a red light. Lucky it was just the arm.

DIANA
Right.

She makes a note on the blue clipboard.

OSCAR
(not looking up)
Car accident. I thought it was the ladder.

LEON
Does the cause matter?

OSCAR
Not to the production. Only to the story you tell.

Leon says nothing. Diana glances between them and marks something else on the blue clipboard.

DIANA
Full company on stage in thirty minutes. I want Act One clean.
"""
